# Hydration and dough strength

Focaccia takes generous olive oil in the pan and dimples pressed in just before baking. A preheated Dutch oven traps steam for the first twenty minutes and gives a blistered crust. Salt slows fermentation, so add it after the autolyse rather than at the very start. Bulk fermentation is done when the dough has grown by about half and shows bubbles at the edges. Shaping creates surface tension so the loaf rises up instead of spreading out.

## Steps

- Salt slows fermentation, so add it after the autolyse rather than at the very start.
- Focaccia takes generous olive oil in the pan and dimples pressed in just before baking.
- A healthy starter doubles within six hours of feeding at room temperature.
